The DEXA-PSYCH trial was conducted at the [Copenhagen Research Centre for Biological and Precision Psychiatry](https://research.regionh.dk/en/organisations/copenhagen-research-centre-for-biological-and-precision-psychiatr/), [Mental Health Centre Copenhagen](https://research.regionh.dk/en/organisations/psykiatrisk-center-k%C3%B8benhavn-bfh/organisations/), [Copenhagen University Hospital](https://research.regionh.dk/en/)---Bispebjerg and Frederiksberg, Copenhagen, Denmark.

Find us on [GitHub](https://github.com/Biological-and-Precision-Psychiatry) and [LinkedIn](https://dk.linkedin.com/company/copenhagen-biological-and-precision-psychiatry). 

The trial also has a [Danish website](https://www.psykiatri-regionh.dk/dexa-psych/Sider/default.aspx) with information for potential participants, medical practitioners and the danish public.


## The DEXA-PSYCH Team


```{r}
#| label: setup_about
#| include: false

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file())
```


```{r}
#| include: false

team <- yaml::read_yaml("docs/team.yml")
cats <- sapply(team, "[[", "category")

# label, URL prefix, URL suffix (the value from team.yml goes in between)
templates <- list(
  orcid    = c("ORCID",          "https://orcid.org/", ""),
  github   = c("GitHub",         "https://github.com/", ""),
  scholar  = c("Google Scholar", "https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=", ""),
  pubmed   = c("PubMed",         "https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=", "%5BAuthor%5D"),
  linkedin = c("LinkedIn",       "https://www.linkedin.com/in/", ""),
  web      = c("Website",        "", "")
)

make_link <- function(key, value) {
  t <- templates[[key]]
  if (key == "pubmed") value <- gsub(" ", "+", value)
  paste0('<a href="', t[2], value, t[3], '">', t[1], '</a>')
}

card <- function(p) {
  links <- vapply(names(p$links),
                  function(k) make_link(k, p$links[[k]]),
                  character(1))
  affiliation <- if (is.null(p$affiliation)) "" else p$affiliation
  paste0(
    '<div class="col"><div class="card h-100"><div class="card-body">\n',
    '<h5 class="card-title">', p$name, '</h5>\n',
    '<p class="card-subtitle text-muted">', p$role, '</p>\n',
    '<p class="card-text small">', affiliation, '</p>\n',
    '<p class="card-text small">', paste(links, collapse = " · "), '</p>\n',
    '</div></div></div>'
  )
}
```

## Funding

The DEXA-PSYCH trial was funded by the following unrestricted research grants to Michael Eriksen Benros: 

- An unrestricted research grant for investigator-initiated trials with a non-commercial focus awarded by [the Novo Nordisk Foundation](https://novonordiskfonden.dk/en/) (grant number NNF21OC0072020)
-  [Mental Health Services in the Capital Region of Denmark](https://research.regionh.dk/en/organisations/psykiatrisk-center-k%C3%B8benhavn-bfh/organisations/)

The funders had no role in the design or conduct of the trial, in the analysis or interpretation of data, or in the communication of trial results.


## Approval

The Trial was approved by

- [The Danish Medicines Agency](https://laegemiddelstyrelsen.dk/en/), 
- [The Danish Health Research Ethics Committee](https://www.regionh.dk/til-fagfolk/Forskning-og-innovation/De-regionale-videnskabsetiske-komiteer/Sider/default.aspx?rhKeywords=De+videnskabsetiske+komiteer), 
- [The Capital Region Knowledge Center for Data Compliance](https://www.rigshospitalet.dk/afdelinger-og-klinikker/hovedorto/forskning/en-indgang-til-phd-livet/sider/datatilsynet-og-dataanmeldelser.aspx), and
- Externally monitored by [the Good Clinical Practice (GCP) unit](https://gcp-enhed.dk/english/)


All participants provided written informed consent.
